root = Path(os.environ["CELLAR_NATIVE_REPLAY_ROOT"])
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
environment = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR=str(root))
command = ["cargo", "test", "-p", "cellar", "--all-features", "--test", "native_node", "--locked", "--"]
selected = f"node_events::event_refusal_clock::{fixture}"

if listed.stdout.splitlines().count(f"{selected}: test") != 1:
    raise SystemExit("Native replay fixture did not select exactly one test")
command += [selected, "--exact", "--nocapture", "--test-threads=1"]
for iteration in range(repetitions):
